ROOM_CALAMITY.title: Calamity
ROOM_CALAMITY.description: Every path passes through here. Each player must take a [red]hardship[/red] to carry for the rest of the run.
CALAMITY_PACT.dead:
[red]You have fallen.[/red] Something offers you a way back.
[gold]Grasp an ally[/gold] to return. They will bear the [red]Unholy Pact[/red].
CALAMITY_PACT.ally:
[gold]{Name}[/gold] has fallen and is reaching for someone to pull them back.
Whoever they grasp bears the [red]Unholy Pact[/red].
ROOM_TRIAL.title: Trial
ROOM_TRIAL.description: Every path passes through here. The party votes on a [gold]Trial[/gold] for this act's boss.
